name: james
description: James DeFleur's house Shorts style. Default for every DeFleur edit; owner/project presets override any key.

caption.font_note: James' masters use Arial Black; Montserrat Black (SIL OFL, Debian fonts-montserrat) is the redistributable stand-in. Put arialbd/ariblk in a project preset font_path when licensed.
caption.always_on_note: James' house rule: captions run for the whole video, including during motion beats. Graphics stay out of safe_rect; plan.caption_suppress is rejected while this is true.

policy_basis.palette: Exact colors from Conversation first v3 and v3.1 SVG/JS/CSS; primary warm/gold/near-black tokens from v3.1.
policy_basis.coverage: v3.1 majority-clean requirement means strictly below 50%; Longevity is 30.4/75.89 = 40.06%.
policy_basis.first_visual: v3.1 instructions: first meaningful supporting visual enters at 3-5 seconds.
policy_basis.labels: Small labels not sentences; 4-word ceiling covers approved labels.
policy_basis.clean_return: 1s minimum encodes clear speaker return; longer uninterrupted stretches remain editorial judgment.
policy_basis.mix: Owner-approved image/mechanism alternation, applied to 30s+ and 3+ beats. Historical motion-only references need explicit, reasoned project relaxation.
